description:
Close the confirmed WhatsApp reaction skin tone gap in feat/whatsapp-integration.

Evidence: ReactionMapper.to_rating/2 accepts bare Unicode thumbs up/down but ignores the same thumbs followed by a standard skin tone modifier. JidoChatBridge.handle_reaction_event/2 therefore skips rating dispatch.

Scope and solution: reuse existing issue zaq-qch; extend the shared mapper to accept exactly one Unicode modifier U+1F3FB through U+1F3FF on thumbs up/down. Preserve ratings 5/1, bare thumbs, existing provider shortcodes, malformed-input rejection, and existing reaction identity/authorization and NodeRouter boundaries. Phone number investigation is outside this epic.

Action reuse assessment: extend the existing pure ReactionMapper.to_rating/2 implementation used by JidoChatBridge.handle_reaction_event/2. Inputs remain provider atom and emoji; outputs remain {:ok, 1 | 5} or :ignored. No new Action, tool exposure, side effects, or permission semantics.

Acceptance: all five tones work for thumbs up/down on WhatsApp; focused mapper tests and properties cover valid and malformed inputs; reaction ingress coverage demonstrates toned thumbs reach the existing rating dispatch with unchanged sender/message context. Preserve existing unrelated behavior.

Approval status: user authorized epic creation only. Existing reaction_mapper_test.exs explicitly expects toned Unicode thumbs to be ignored; obtain explicit approval of that expectation change before editing the existing test.

Validation when implementation is authorized: mix q, isolated mapper/reaction tests, required coverage checks, and final mix precommit under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Pure mapping fix does not require new feature E2E.

Execution: zaq-qch implements and validates the fix; close this epic after its acceptance criteria and final review are satisfied.
title: [zaq-3f5] WhatsApp reaction skin tone support
